projectDescription: A lightweight BepInEx/MelonLoader mod for Gorilla Tag that redirects the game to an unofficial private server with full cosmetics support.
keyFeatures: Redirects Gorilla Tag to an independent private server (Solaristy OS) without bans
Unlocks all cosmetics for free using Harmony patches on the CosmeticsController
Bypasses Steam/PlayFab authentication using a custom PlayFab title ID and anonymous login
Auto-accepts Terms of Service and legal agreements so players can jump in immediately
Disables the Mothership anti-cheat system for uninterrupted gameplay
Compatible with both BepInEx and MelonLoader mod loaders
Custom Gorilla Computer startup screen showing live player count
publicApiSurface: Plugin (BepInEx BaseUnityPlugin / MelonLoader MelonMod entry point)
PurchasePatch (routes item purchases through buyFreeCosmetic cloud function)
